#: Calls into patched-in code (vb-zh-x2.1 HANZI) whose callee ends `cmp/test ...; ret` (one ret) and whose caller branches on those flags. Value: the callee's last compare (bytes, read from the XBE and checked against the hook). Used by the pipeline (generated functions) and by tools/hurricane/lift_funcs.sh (functions merged into hand-written files).
#0x0021F557: The hook ends `sub eax, 2; ret`, which cannot be redone in the caller (it writes eax). The caller reads only ZF after it (jne at 0x21F55C, x360_audit flag_walk), and `test eax, eax` on the result gives the same ZF.
